# fw self-update

> Reference of the fw self-update command: Update from GitHub Releases, verify SHA-256, keep the previous binary as .prev. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/self-update/

Update from GitHub Releases, verify SHA-256, keep the previous binary as .prev

## Usage

```bash
fw self-update [--check] [--version <tag>]
```

## Aliases

`fw update` runs `fw self-update`. `fw upgrade` runs `fw self-update`.

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--check` |  |
| `--version` | `<tag>` |
